qualifier: vocal and observational learning, sensory gating
name: Locomotor, sensorimotor, vocal and social behavior
rationale: Members are organism-level neural behaviors (locomotion, reflexes, touch/auditory/visual responses, vocalization, social learning) plus the brain regions underlying them; vocal/social/learning behaviors and exploratory locomotion distinguish it from confusables centred on glycinergic transmission or MECP2 regulation.

qualifier: B and T lineage commitment with V(D)J recombination
name: Early B and T lymphocyte development with V(D)J recombination
rationale: Members cover pre-B and double-positive thymocyte stages, lineage commitment and V(D)J recombination, distinguishing the theme from confusables centred on mature B cell activation and T cell receptor signaling.

name: Regulation of receptor internalization and recycling to cell surface
rationale: Members regulate receptor (including GPCR) internalization, endocytic recycling and cell-surface protein localization, unlike confusables focused on postsynaptic neurotransmitter receptor trafficking or Rab/ARF signaling.

name: Factor XII–kallikrein contact activation and hereditary angioedema
rationale: All members concern FXIIa/plasma kallikrein-driven intrinsic coagulation, its C1-inhibitor regulation and defects, and amyloid-triggered FXII activation, which the common-pathway, fibrinolysis and VWF confusables lack.

qualifier: cadherin, PTEN and PD-L1 gene regulation
name: Transcriptional repression and DNA-binding control of cadherin, PTEN, PD-L1 genes
rationale: Members are negative regulation of transcription/DNA binding and gene-specific transcriptional control of CDH1, CDH11, PTEN, PD-L1 and TGFBR3 (including ALK-STAT3 nuclear events), unlike PAX3, RUNX3 or mesenchymal confusables.

qualifier: proliferation, migration, fusion and differentiation control
name: Myoblast proliferation, migration, fusion and differentiation control
rationale: Members all regulate myoblast fate, proliferation, migration, fusion and myotube differentiation, whereas confusables emphasize satellite cell maintenance or muscle organ/tissue development.

name: Intraflagellar transport, cilium assembly–disassembly and centriole duplication
rationale: Members cover IFT, transition zone and basal body anchoring, cilium assembly/disassembly and centriole elongation/duplication, distinguishing it from motile-cilium, cargo-targeting and centrosome-positioning confusables.

qualifier: CSF1 and DAP12 signaling, cell fusion, bone resorption
name: CSF1–DAP12 signaling in osteoclastogenesis and macrophage fusion
rationale: Members center on M-CSF and DAP12 signaling driving macrophage proliferation and fusion, osteoclast differentiation and bone resorption, which microglial and GM-CSF/monocyte confusables lack.

name: Aquaporin-mediated water, glycerol and urea transport
rationale: All members describe passive aquaporin transport of water, glycerol, urea and amides, distinct from vasopressin-regulated renal water confusables and fatty acid/thermogenesis confusables.

name: Platelet adhesion to collagen and aggregation regulation
rationale: Members cover platelet adhesion via GPIb-IX-V to collagen and positive/negative regulation of aggregation, unlike GPVI, VWF-variant or ADP/thrombin receptor signaling confusables.

name: Hair follicle, nail and ectodermal appendage morphogenesis
rationale: Members concern ectodermal differentiation, hair follicle placode formation and cycling, and nail and epidermal morphogenesis, distinguishing it from keratinocyte/melanocyte and tooth development confusables.

qualifier: IRAK/TRAF to IRF3/7, herpes simplex encephalitis deficiencies
name: Endosomal TLR signaling to IRF3/7 and HSE immunodeficiencies
rationale: Members cover TLR3 and TLR7/8/9 endosomal trafficking and IRAK/TRAF/TBK1 signaling to IKK and IRF3/7 plus the UNC93B1/TRAF3/TICAM1/TLR3 deficiencies causing HSE, unlike confusables on TRIF-mediated cell death or cGAS/IFN regulation.

qualifier: NHEJ and HR/NHEJ pathway choice, BRCA defects
name: Double-strand break sensing, NHEJ and repair pathway choice
rationale: Members cover DSB sensing/ATM signaling, classical and alternative NHEJ, regulation of HR versus NHEJ and BRCA1/BARD1/BRCA2 defects, whereas confusables emphasize resection, strand exchange or ADP-ribosylation.

qualifier: E2F/RB G1/S control and G2/M checkpoints
name: Cell cycle: E2F-driven G1/S control and G2/M transition
rationale: Members span RB/E2F G1/S transcription, cyclin-CDK regulation, G2/M checkpoints and mitotic entry, distinguishing it from confusables focused on replication origin licensing and T-cell-stimulated division modules.

qualifier: keratinocyte development and skin barrier formation
name: Epidermal morphogenesis, keratinocyte development and skin barrier formation
rationale: Members cover epidermis and skin morphogenesis, keratinocyte differentiation, cornified envelope and barrier establishment (with sebaceous gland and ABCA12 ichthyosis), unlike confusables on keratinocyte proliferation, cell adhesion or lipoxygenase metabolism.

name: Cohesin-mediated sister chromatid cohesion establishment and resolution
rationale: Members all concern cohesin loading, establishment, maintenance and resolution of sister chromatid cohesion, unlike spindle and chromosome condensation confusables.

qualifier: to MAP2K and p38 MAP kinase
name: Ras-family GTPase signaling to MAP2K and p38
rationale: Members concern Ras-like GTPase (Ras, RIT, RIN) signal transduction to MAP kinase cascades including MAP2K mutants, unlike confusables centred on RAS GAP regulation, NTRK3 or RAF/MRAS activation.

qualifier: telomerase assembly and recruitment to telomeres
name: Telomerase assembly, telomere recruitment and telomere extension
rationale: Members cover telomerase holoenzyme assembly, protein recruitment to telomeres and telomerase extension, unlike confusables on telomere capping, C-strand synthesis or Cajal body localization.

core: Amino acid neurotransmitter transport and metabolism
name: GABA, glutamate and glycine neurotransmitter transport and metabolism
rationale: Members cover synthesis, vesicular loading, release, reuptake and transporter disorders of GABA, glutamate/aspartate and glycine (with serine), distinguishing it from monoamine and cholinergic confusables.

qualifier: APC/C regulation, cohesion resolution and spindle checkpoint
name: Mitotic progression and exit: APC/C, cohesion, spindle checkpoint
rationale: Members cover APC/C activation and substrate degradation, sister chromatid cohesion/separation, spindle assembly checkpoint, PLK1/AURKA and cytokinesis, unlike confusables on chromosome condensation, nuclear envelope or G1/S–G2/M regulation.

name: FGFR1c–Klotho and PTH phosphate signaling in bone mineralization
rationale: Members link FGFR1c–Klotho (FGF23) signaling, PTH and phosphate responses to positive regulation of bone mineralization, unlike confusables on phosphate transporters and tooth mineralization.

name: Bone mineralization regulation by FGFR1c–Klotho, phosphate and PTH
rationale: Members are positive and negative regulation of bone mineralization during maturation together with FGFR1c–Klotho, PTH and phosphate responses, distinguishing it from tooth mineralization and vitamin D confusables.

name: Collagen and elastic fiber assembly in aortic wall development
rationale: Members cover collagen biosynthesis and crosslinking, elastic fiber assembly and ECM assembly regulation with ascending aorta and aortic smooth muscle morphogenesis, unlike confusables on MMP-mediated degradation or basement membrane.

name: Inborn errors of leucine and valine catabolism
rationale: Members are leucine and valine catabolism and their enzyme deficiencies (isovaleric acidemia, MCC, 3-methylglutaconic aciduria, HIBCH, ECHS1, beta-ketothiolase), unlike biotin or isoleucine/short-chain fatty acid confusables.

name: Embryonic axis patterning: somitogenesis and neural plate/hindbrain segmentation
rationale: Members cover body axis specification, somite formation and segmentation clock, neural plate and border formation, and hindbrain/rhombomere boundaries, distinguishing it from Hox cluster modules and axial mesoderm/neural tube confusables.
